heading_en: Exposures to Owner-Occupied Residential Real Estate, etc.
summary_ja: 自己居住用住宅ローン等で適格性の要件を満たすもののリスク・ウェイトをLTV比率に応じ二十〜七十パーセントとし、要件を満たさないものは七十五パーセント、第二順位以下の抵当権は一・二五倍（LTV五十以下を除く）とし、適格性の要件とLTV比率を定義する。
summary_en: Owner-occupied residential mortgages meeting the eligibility requirements take 20–70% by LTV ratio (others 75%; junior liens ×1.25 unless LTV ≤ 50), with the eligibility requirements and LTV ratio defined.

terms.ja: 自己居住用不動産等向けエクスポージャー
terms.en: exposures to owner-occupied residential real estate, etc.

paragraphs: Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding Article, the risk weight of exposures relating to the acquisition, etc. of housing that fall under either of the following items (hereinafter referred to as "exposures to owner-occupied residential real estate, etc.") and that satisfy all of the eligibility requirements shall be as set out in the left column of the following table, according to the category of LTV ratio of the exposure to owner-occupied residential real estate, etc. listed in that table. {{T:p79t0}} (i) A housing loan satisfying all of the following requirements: (a) That it is a loan to an individual. (b) That the housing on which the mortgage is created is for the obligor's own residence (excluding second homes and the like). (c) That the use of funds is limited to the construction, acquisition, extension or renovation of housing and other housing-related expenses. (ii) An exposure satisfying all of the following requirements: (a) That it is a loan to an individual. (b) That the use of funds is limited to the construction, acquisition, extension or renovation of housing and other housing-related expenses, and a mortgage has been created on that housing. (c) That it falls under either of the following: (1) It is not for the purpose of renting out. (2) Where it is for the purpose of renting out, repayment does not depend solely on rent or other income from the housing that is the purpose of the funds. (d) That the amount of exposures to a single obligor (before applying the credit risk mitigation techniques provided in Section 6, and limited to those whose use of funds is limited to the construction, acquisition, extension or renovation of housing and other housing-related expenses (excluding those whose repayment depends solely on rent or other income from that housing)) is 100 million yen or less.
The risk weight where an exposure to owner-occupied residential real estate, etc. does not satisfy the eligibility requirements shall be 75%.

The "eligibility requirements" in the preceding two paragraphs means the following requirements. (i) That construction of the property on which the mortgage is created has been completed; provided, however, that this shall not apply to exposures to owner-occupied residential real estate, etc. falling under paragraph (1), item (i). (ii) That the mortgage is first-ranking; provided, however, that this shall not apply where the mortgage is second-ranking or lower and the LTV ratio is 100 or less. (iii) That the obligor's repayment capacity has been assessed as adequate based on appropriate underwriting standards (meaning standards under which indicators for measuring the obligor's repayment capacity are defined and the levels of those indicators for assessing that capacity are set; the same applies in paragraph (3), item (iii) of the following Article). (iv) That the valuation of the property pledged as collateral for the credit satisfies all of the following requirements: (a) That sound and prudent valuation criteria have been established. (b) That it is independent of the credit process. (c) That it does not depend materially on the obligor's repayment capacity or performance. (d) That expected future increases in the value of the property are not reflected. (e) That, where the current value of the property may be overstated relative to the value expected to be sustained over the term of the credit, appropriate adjustments have been made. (f) That, where the market value of the property can be obtained, it does not exceed that market value. (v) That documents on the information necessary for continuously monitoring credit risk over the term of the credit (including information on the obligor's repayment capacity provided in item (iii) and on the property valuation provided in the preceding item) have been properly prepared.

The "LTV ratio" in paragraph (1) and the preceding paragraph means the value, expressed as a percentage, of the ratio obtained by dividing the amount specified in item (i) by the amount specified in item (ii). (i) The amount of the exposure as of the calculation reference date on which the risk weight specified in paragraph (1) is applied (before applying the credit risk mitigation techniques provided in Section 6; the same applies hereinafter from this Article through Article 37-4); provided, however, that where the mortgage is second-ranking or lower, it shall be that exposure amount plus the amount of exposures as of the calculation reference date secured by the property pledged to holders of prior-ranking and equal-ranking mortgages (excluding the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach itself). (ii) The amount calculated, by a method satisfying the requirements listed in item (iv) of the preceding paragraph, as the value of the property pledged as collateral at the time the credit was extended. In this case, where the case listed in (a) applies, that amount shall be revised downward, and where the case listed in (b) applies, that amount may be revised upward. (a) Where a permanent decrease in the value of the property due to an idiosyncratic event is evident. (b) Where the value of the property increases due to extension or renovation.

Of the exposures to owner-occupied residential real estate, etc. that satisfy all of the eligibility requirements provided in paragraph (3), the risk weight of those for which the mortgage of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach is second-ranking or lower shall be the value obtained by multiplying the risk weight specified in paragraph (1) by 1.25; provided, however, that where the LTV ratio provided in the preceding paragraph is 50 or less, it is not necessary to multiply by 1.25.
